title: F-104S Starfighter

sources.title: JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)
HyperScale: 1/1 F-104 Starfighter control stick grip review

intro: The F-104S is the Italian interceptor version of the Starfighter, built by Aeritalia, with the R21G radar and the radar-guided Sparrow and Aspide missiles; early interceptors had no gun. It keeps the F-104G basics, so this guide follows the F-104G guide; Sparrow-related grip functions are not checked.

panels.name: Control stick
panels.text: The centre stick. Only the trim hat and the gun trigger are confirmed; the other buttons follow the grip family of that time and are marked as inferred.
panels.context: The HyperScale review of a real grip shows its shape and buttons.

controls.name: Gun trigger

positions.name: Second step
positions.text: Fire the gun (if fitted) or AIM-9.

controls.text: The trigger at the front of the grip. The first step runs the gun camera; the second fires the gun (on aircraft that kept it) or a Sidewinder missile.
controls.context: Early F-104S interceptors had the gun removed to make room for the Sparrow missile electronics. The gun camera step is inferred.
